paragraphs.text:
Scattered among the books on Keh’s shelves are some ominously 
ancient tomes bound in suspect hides. He also seems to doing 
his best to stand in front of the internal door in his office. If you 
want to ask him what’s behind the door, go to 346. Or you can 
leave him, and return to 206, or go to any Cairo location on the 
Egypt Location Table.
